“He brought me to the banqueting house, and His banner over me was love. . . . His left hand is under my head, and His right hand doth embrace me” (Song Sol. ii. 4, 6). Thank God we can come under the banner to-day if we will.…

…How many men have been overcome by some little thing! Turn a moment to the Song of Solomon, the second chapter, fifteenth verse: “Take us the foxes, the little foxes that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.” A great many people seem to think these little things—getting out of patience,…
…the surrender of obedience and trust, have the rule, the free disposal of every faculty. Wait for Him—He can, He will in power reveal and impart the Holiness of the Father and the Son.7
